answer: Agents resist Sybil attacks by anchoring identity to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To participate in economic consensus, each node deposits a base collateral like copper reserves, but registration costs scale superlinearly as $C(n) = k \cdot 2^n$ per operator. This mechanism triggers exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms, turning a rising tide of fake identities into an unviable financial plume of burning capital.
